title: Bring discovery to the surface that needs no install
objective: Browse, search, area narrowing and the honesty layer on the web, so what is visible without installing is exactly what is visible inside Kafoo.
acceptance_criteria: the web calls the same discover function — no second data path and no second visibility model
the web calls judge-results too; a surface with results and no honesty layer would ship the confident wrong answer this feature exists to prevent (FR-026)
area narrowing and the empty-area state match the app
SC-009 verified field by field: what is visible without installing is identical to what is visible inside
the same ask-once-and-refuse as the app, stored in the browser rather than by Kafoo, with somewhere findable to change it later
notes:
Analyze caught the gap this closes: T183 wired the web to discover but not to judge-results, which would have shipped a Customer-facing surface that returns results with nothing checking whether they answer the question. Small package, three dependencies, and it is the last thing between E3 and being done.
